name: Tauno Monitor
blurb: Features: • Easy to use • Customizable colours • Remembers the last used settings • Automatically reconnects to the serial port if the connection is lost • Can log data to a file •
description:
Features:

• Easy to use

• Customizable colours

• Remembers the last used settings

• Automatically reconnects to the serial port if the connection is lost

• Can log data to a file

• Displays data in different formats: ASCII, BIN, OCT or DEC

• Plots labeled numeric values from comma-separated serial data in a live sidebar graph

• Can open multiple instances

Depending on your system you may need to add a user to dialout group to open serial ports:

sudo usermod -a -G dialout $USER

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
